exercicio.statement:
Jeff and Shannon are working on their math homework, but Shannon feels Jeff is going ahead too fast without giving any help! So they decided to compare their homework to see if Jeff really was going ahead. Use the number lines to find out.
Jeff did 1/3 of his problems.
Shannon did 2/9 of her problems.
Is Shannon right?

steps.instruction: Divide Jeff's number line into equal parts for 1/3 of his problems.
Mark Jeff's point for 1/3 on the divided number line.
Divide Shannon's number line into equal parts for 2/9 of her problems.
Mark Shannon's point for 2/9 on the divided number line.
Choose the statement that correctly compares Jeff's and Shannon's completed work.
steps.expectedAnswer: Yes; Jeff was going ahead with the homework.
